limits: Only part1 of the source-marked two-part A message is present here. The Prague/Mackensen/Teschen clause is incomplete; no continuation or operative transport decision is invented.
A1 retains raw TS8HESCHICHE. The adjective is contextually suggestive of Czech, but no source edit or digit relabel is imposed to normalize it.
B1 preserves ABMMD and trailing LEBENSMITTELM; these anomalous/abbreviated labels are not silently normalized.
B2 retains NOXJ0192SMXBEWEGEXBERLIN. C2 retains RMJAJJ970GEHXOP. No reference numerals or J labels are historically authenticated or relabeled.
C1 keeps HABENGROSSEANZAHL without a grammatical normalization. Its first-row GFXAF is a direct source reading, not a two-mask fill.
B1/B2 and C1/C2 are consecutive numbered parts under their respective single printed headers. These joins do not merge the two separate telegrams.
All five frames are native source lengths; no coordinates are inserted, deleted, excluded or reordered. A1 contains exactly eight printed dashes.
